title: Adding a question
_note: BCP admin recipe add-question. Cut from ski-demo_add-question_dev_09-19-47_v4.mp4 (125.32s), recorded to the v15 standard — rings, click-through navigation, the dashboard's own Logout card. TWELVE screens: the draft's save, the walk back through the dashboard and the second trip to the question list are merged, because to a viewer they are one act. Screen edges measured off the mp4 and kept in bounds_v3.json.
_wps_note: From 01-first-time-ordering/script_v33.json, measured 31 words / 9.01s. Nothing for THIS video is rendered yet.
_pauses_note: One 0.8s exit pause per scene, at the end of the line. A 0.5s lead-in is NOT here: `pauses` can only place a gap after matched text or at the end, so the lead-in comes from the scene's footage hold.
_estimated_video_note: 12 scenes. 201 words / 3.44 wps = 58.5s of speech, + 12 lead-ins at 0.5s = 6.0s, + 12 exit pauses at 0.8s = 9.6s. ESTIMATE — recompute from the audio once it exists.

scenes.label: dashboard
scenes.line: This is your dashboard. {0.8} Questions are shared by every store. Click Questions.

scenes.label: question-list
scenes.line: This lists every question you have. {0.5} Click the plus button to add a new one.

scenes.label: new-question
scenes.line: Give the question a name. {0.8} Then choose its type. Select One gives the renter a short list to pick from. {0.8} Now create it.

scenes.label: question-inquiry
scenes.line: Now the details. {0.8} The inquiry is what the renter reads. {0.8} The label is the short name on their form. {0.8} Add the options they can choose between, {0.5} set the status to Active, {0.5} and update.

scenes.label: question-status
scenes.line: A new question starts as a draft.

scenes.label: attributes
scenes.line: The attributes hold the choices a renter picks from. {0.5} Add one value for each option you want to offer.

scenes.label: back-to-questions
scenes.line: A new question starts as a draft, {0.5} and a draft cannot be attached to anything. {0.8} So we go back to Questions to switch it on.

scenes.label: find-the-question
scenes.line: Type part of the name, {0.5} then pick your question from the list.

scenes.label: the-question
scenes.line: This is the question you just made. {0.5} Everything you typed is still here.

scenes.label: activate
scenes.line: Change the status to Active, {0.8} then update. {0.8} A requirement can use it now.

scenes.label: back-to-dashboard
scenes.line: Head back to the dashboard. {0.5} You can get here anytime with the command + K short keys.
